name: devx
description: Multi-agent software delivery for repositories with a discoverable build and verification workflow. An Opus orchestrator dispatches specialized Sonnet and Haiku agents that design, plan, build, review, document, and ship through durable .devx/ files and an FTS5-indexed knowledge vault.

vault_path.title: Knowledge vault directory
vault_path.description: Override the bundled curated dev-knowledge vault with a larger shared one. Leave empty to use the plugin's vault/.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Used for github_search code search if the gh CLI is not authenticated. Stored in the system keychain where supported, otherwise in Claude Code's credentials store.
